scenes.script_line: One idea — a place well cared for cares for those who inhabit it — expressed at a farm, on a beach, in a museum, at a wedding. Different stages, same play. scenes.script_line: New projects, new partnerships, ideas at various stages — some will happen, some won't. What I can promise you is that growth, for us, is never expansion for its own sake. Every new point in the constellation has to regenerate something — a building, a community, a piece of land — or we don't do it. We grow the way the farm grows: season by season, roots first.
scenes.visual_direction: Growth the way the farm grows — season by season, roots first

scenes.script_line: You joined a company that is trying to prove something to an entire industry: that hospitality can give back more than it takes.
